# foundry_routine (Data Source)

~> **Preview:** This data source requires `enable_preview = ["routines"]` on the provider. Preview features may change or be removed in any provider release without following semantic versioning.

Looks up an existing routine by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# foundry_routine is a preview feature. It requires an explicit opt-in on
# the provider before it can be used, and preview features may change or be
# removed in any provider release without following semantic versioning.
provider "foundry" {
  account_name   = var.foundry_account_name
  project_name   = var.foundry_project_name
  enable_preview = ["routines"]
}

data "foundry_routine" "daily_summary" {
  name = "daily-summary"
}

output "routine_agent_name" {
  value = data.foundry_routine.daily_summary.agent_name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the routine to look up.

### Read-Only

- `action_type` (String) Action invoked when the routine fires.
- `agent_name` (String) Name of the agent invoked when the routine fires.
- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the routine was created.
- `description` (String) Description of the routine.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the routine is enabled and will fire on its trigger.
- `input` (String) Input passed to the agent when the routine fires.
- `session_id` (String) Session identifier used for `invoke_agent_invocations_api` actions.
- `trigger` (Attributes) The routine's trigger. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--trigger))
- `updated_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the routine was last updated.

<a id="nestedatt--trigger"></a>
### Nested Schema for `trigger`

Read-Only:

- `at` (String) ISO 8601 timestamp at which the routine fires once, set when `type` is `timer`.
- `cron_expression` (String) Cron expression defining the trigger schedule, set when `type` is `schedule`.
- `time_zone` (String) IANA time zone used to interpret `cron_expression`.
- `type` (String) Trigger type, `schedule` or `timer`.
